worldcombat.skill.glare.summary: Rear up and spread the belly pattern forward into a fan that freezes every enemy in it who can see the user. It deals no damage; its breadth is its strength. Ducking behind cover, stepping to the side or standing outside the fan leaves a target untouched. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.glare.description.0: The fan reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s degree opening; every target in it needs an unobstructed line to the user.
worldcombat.skill.glare.description.1: Caught targets are paralysed for %1$s: while paralysed they move at half speed and every action has a 25%% chance to fail. The cost is the shortest reach and the longest windup.
worldcombat.skill.glare.spread.on: Spread hood: opening x1.35, windup -2, cooldown x0.9, but reach x0.85 and paralysis x0.85 - to freeze a crowd at once.
worldcombat.skill.glare.spread.off: Rear up: opening x0.7, reach x1.15 and paralysis x1.2 - to pin a single hard target from afar.
worldcombat.skill.glare.timing: Instant fan: range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.glare.use.0: Freeze a pack closing in all at once
worldcombat.skill.glare.use.1: Pin the toughest melee threat in place
worldcombat.skill.glare.use.2: Force foes to round the fan or fall back
worldcombat.skill.glare.preference.sprea: On: opening x1.35, windup -2, cooldown x0.9, but reach x0.85 and paralysis x0.85, to freeze a crowd at once. Off: rear up, opening x0.7, reach x1.15 and paralysis x1.2, to pin a single hard target from afar.
worldcombat.skill.glare.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of staring. Larger values chase harder and glare past the fan more often.
worldcombat.skill.glare.preference.ai.pr: When on, each extra enemy inside the real fan (opening, reach, line of sight) raises priority by 8 (max 85) so the crowd is frozen first; when off, all threats rank the same.
worldcombat.skill.glare.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to glare; when off, it only glares at what it can see from where it stands.
